為[Nether's Exoticism](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/nethers-exoticism)添加更多[Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)的砧板食譜：

- 所有樹木類型的去皮、回收
- 從仙人掌莖中獲取更多染料

![木材切割](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FClZlLMF/images/a53ff5d2ca187806c916905f65cb974b00491cbd.png) ![仙人掌莖切割](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FClZlLMF/images/8ff9ea9987344cc0db6e5964ede3329492cfcb7c.png)
